focus: future concern can coexist with costly present-day helping, so future-facing worlds should publish matched-cost present-versus-future sacrifice semantics rather than assuming a fixed tradeoff

fairness-driven uptake depends on which reference group bears burdens, so future-facing policy worlds should publish household, local, subgroup, societal, and future-generation fairness semantics explicitly
implementor_warning: Do not treat future-facing uptake as generic Golden-Rule progress until the world publishes whether it changed present-cost alignment, beneficiary salience, burden scale, and fairness reference groups.
